item.title: View From The Matbird Seat
item.description: By Bruce Bartels Good January Day, Matbird readers. Wow, it is cold outside today. My pickup truck measured a -14 around 6:00 am when I trekked the four miles to town for a quick workout. Gotta remember the sage advice, “this too shall pass!” It has taken a long time to climb back up into my perch on the Matbird Seat.
